name: Mercado Beira-Rio
description: Cross the bridge to Gaia for this vibrant market, famous for its petiscos. It's the perfect stop after a Port wine tasting.
longDescription:
Mercado Beira-Rio is a recurring food market held in Vila Nova de Gaia, directly across the Douro River from Porto. This particular iteration spans two days in early May 2026, focusing on local culinary offerings. The market provides a platform for various vendors to present regional specialties, particularly small plates and snacks, reflecting the gastronomic traditions of the area.

Visitors to Mercado Beira-Rio can expect a lively atmosphere with numerous food stalls. The market is situated in Vila Nova de Gaia, offering views of the Porto riverside. It is a suitable destination for those interested in sampling local cuisine, often serving as a complementary activity after exploring the Port wine cellars in the vicinity. The event caters to a general audience, including families and individuals.

Entry to Mercado Beira-Rio is free. The market is easily accessible from Porto by crossing the Dom Luís I Bridge. From the Porto side, it is a short walk from the Jardim do Morro metro station (yellow line D) in Gaia, or a slightly longer walk from São Bento station in Porto. The venue is generally accessible.
